The main takeaway from our work is that
, in heterogeneous channel setting, a CR should probe more channels than it can sense and access.

, in the heterogeneous channel environment, a single CR should explore the channel by sensing, probing, and accessing in a sequential manner, instead of sensing and probing in parallel as in previous works.
